messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a **complete calendar of “long‑weekend” public holidays** that would affect most Canadians during 2023.  
A *long weekend* here means a statutory holiday that either lands on a weekday next to Saturday/Sunday or has been moved (“observed”) so that the break extends over three consecutive days.

> ⚠️ **Important:** Some holidays vary by province/territory (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day). If your users live in a specific region, filter the rows that match their jurisdiction(s).

| Date | Holiday | Province/Territory | Notes |
|------|---------|--------------------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year's Day | All | Observed Mon 2 if Jan 1 falls Sunday (not applicable in 2023 – it was Wednesday). |
| **February 20** | Family Day | AB, BC, MB, ON, SK | Creates a Thursday–Saturday stretch. |
| **March 29** | Saint Patrick's Day | NB, PEI | Only NB & PEI have a statutory holiday; creates a Tuesday–Thursday break. |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | All except NL, NT, YT | Falls on Friday → 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All | Celebrated on last Monday before May 25 → 3‑day weekend. |
| **June 19** | National Indigenous Peoples Day | AB, BC, MB, QC, SK | Falls on Monday → 3‑day weekend. |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | All | July 1, 2023 fell on a Saturday → no extra day off unless employer gives time. |
| **September 18** | Civic Holiday | Many provinces (AB, BC, MB, NS, NU, ON, PEI, SK, YT) | Usually celebrated on first Monday in September → 3‑day weekend. |
| **October 9** | Labour Day | All | First Monday in Oct → 3‑day weekend. |
| **November 11** | Remembrance Day | All | Observed on Monday in 2023 → 3‑day weekend. |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | All | Falls on Monday → 3‑day weekend. |

### How to Use This Data in Your App

```json
[
  {"date":"2023-01-02","holiday":"New Year's Day","province":"All"},
  {"date":"2023-02-20","holiday":"Family Day","province":["AB","BC","MB","ON","SK"]},
  ...
]
```

If you prefer a flat list without province filtering, simply drop the `province` field or keep `"All"` where appropriate.

---

#### Quick Reference Table (by month)

| Month | Long Weekend Dates (Mon‑Wed) | Typical Break Length |
|-------|------------------------------|---------------------|
| January | Jan 2 (Observed NYE) | 3 days |
| February | Feb 20 (Fam.) | 3 days |
| March | Mar 28‑30 (St.Pat.) | 3 days |
| April | Apr 5‑7 (Good Fri) | 3 days |
| May | May 21‑23 (Vic.) | 3 days |
| June | Jun 18‑20 (Indigenous Peop.) | 3 days |
| September | Sep 15‑17 (Civic) | 3 days |
| October | Oct 8‑10 (Labour) | 3 days |
| November | Nov 10‑12 (Remem.) | 3 days |
| December | Dec 24‑26 (Boxing) | 3 days |

Feel free to plug this data directly into your scheduling engine—just remember to respect local variations!
